notes: The vocative אֲדֹנָי is written without *O* here, so nothing is supplied to its unit under rule 36; the 1cs suffix is `unrepresented` under rule 57 because the ASV writes no possessive anywhere in the title.
*Let ... be* is read as one volitive copular frame on הָיָה under rule 17, discontinuous around the subject by rule 25, rather than divided between a supplied auxiliary and a copula.
s005: the ASV renders the object bare (*hear my voice*), spending no word on the בְּ's own relation, so it is `unrepresented` under rule 40.
